facts.fact: Biometric Update, reporting a government announcement after a review of the three-year digital transformation operational plan, says the plan is part of the National Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2044 and names components with a date for one of them (an interoperability platform expected in the fourth quarter of 2026); no cost is given.

The article says the Digital Transformation and Innovation Agency (ATDI), "created in March to oversee the country's digital transformation", is developing the interoperability platform, national digital ID and government data-centre components; it names no act and no budget line for the strategy.

systems.owner: Government of Mozambique; ATDI named as overseeing digital transformation
Government; reviewed under the Minister of State Administration and Public Service

note: The article names the strategy and its period but does not describe its scope and states no adoption act, so facts are recorded with class empty; it gives no standing verb for the strategy itself.
